name: Quito & the Avenue of Volcanoes
about: Dry season Jun–Sep has the clearest volcano views and safest climbing conditions; Mar–Apr is the rainiest stretch, when Cotopaxi is often clouded over.
overview: Ecuador's high-altitude capital and the chain of volcanoes stretching south of it — colonial architecture, cloud-forest birding, and some of South America's most accessible volcano trekking.
costOverview: Quito itself is one of the cheapest capital cities in South America to eat and get around in — day tours to Cotopaxi and Quilotoa are the main real expense.
monthlyWeather: mild with variable rain, cool mornings typical of Quito's highland climate
